params.task: create an android habit tracker app

response:
REQUIREMENTS BEFORE BUILDING — ask the user, do not answer these yourself:
1. What are the core screens and capabilities of the app? (e.g. Interactive Dashboard with List/Detail navigation and local SQLite storage) — it sets the navigation graph and data models.
2. What UI style and color theme should it follow? (e.g. Material 3 Modern Dark, Clean Minimalist Light) — it generates the Theme and Color tokens.
